notes: «محمد» (the second, bare) is kept as written: not identified, the same as the other bare names in the chain
«أبي الخليل، أو ابن أبي الخليل» are alternatives at one level (rule 2)
«ولم يذكر زيد بن أرقم» names Zayd as a transmitter in another version of the saying: a variant group, not a route
«ولم يرفعه» says this version is not raised to the Prophet: noted; the chain ends at أبي الخليل
